# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 14 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 14 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_014_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 3, Chapter 6

**1** In the middle of the plain she showed me a great white rock, and in the rock a doorway had been hewn — more brilliant than the sun itself; I was astonished at its radiance. **2** Standing around the doorway were twelve virgins: the four stationed at the corners of the doorway appeared more glorious than the rest, though all of them were glorious. **3** On the outside of the doorway stood two young men, and between them I saw four others of more glorious appearance, clothed in dark garments, with their shoulders bare and their hair unbound, looking somewhat sorrowful. **4** The six builders gave orders to these young men to carry stones for the building. They brought stones from the plain and from a nearby lake. **5** The stones from the plain were already ready for use — they had been hewn, and they were laid into the building as they came, one on top of another, so smoothly that their joints could not be detected. **6** The stones from the lake, when placed in the building, became transparent like glass — shining and brilliant — and adorned the whole building. **7** I noticed that the aged woman had vanished from the scene. After a little while I looked and saw a young woman clothed in bridal attire, with dark slippers and a wreath of asphodel. **8** I said to her, "Are you really in glory, my lady? Who are you?" She answered, "I am the Church." I said, "Why are you appearing as this young bride? Aren't you the aged woman I have seen before?" She replied, "I am the same."

---

*LOGOS note: The Church's youth = the eschatological renewal of the community. The bridal image echoes Revelation 21:2 (the new Jerusalem as bride). Asphodel — traditional Greek flower of the dead — worn at a wedding may signal the Church as resurrection community.*
